profile.headline: Senior Backend Software Engineer | API Design, Cloud Systems, Team Ownership | Agentic Workflows
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer focused on building reliable, scalable backend systems, distributed services, and production APIs.

At Alphatec Spine, I design and develop software supporting real-world medical workflows using C#, .NET, EF Core, PostgreSQL, Azure, Service Bus, Redis, Docker, and Kubernetes. My work spans backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, system performance, CI/CD, and production reliability, with an emphasis on building systems that are maintainable and can evolve confidently over time.

I take ownership across the software lifecycle, from architecture and technical planning through implementation, deployment, troubleshooting, and release. I work closely across Engineering, Product, Systems, Verification, Regulatory, and DevOps, helping drive technical decisions that balance delivery needs with long-term scalability and stability.

I also use AI tooling to improve the software development lifecycle, including MCP integrations, agentic workflows, AI-assisted planning and implementation, and loop engineering built around iterative execution, evaluation, and refinement. I’m particularly interested in moving AI beyond a coding shortcut and toward dependable engineering workflows.

Beyond implementation, I bring a strong technical leadership and continuous-improvement mindset. I’m a certified Scrum Master and believe strongly in ownership, disciplined execution, thoughtful engineering, and building systems and teams people can trust.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Backend Engineer & Technical Lead

* .NET Microservices & REST API Development
* Azure Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure
* Kubernetes / AKS / Docker / Helm
* PostgreSQL / Redis / Entity Framework Core
* Event-Driven Architecture / Azure Service Bus
* Auth0 / Entra ID / Managed Identity
* Azure DevOps / CI/CD / Release Management
* DICOM / Medical Software Development
* Technical Leadership / Scrum Master
* Cross-Functional Release & VE Support
* Regulated Software Documentation

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: 1950 Camino Vida Roble, Carlsbad CA 92008 · On-site
positions.description:
- Owned backend and cloud development for a multi-service Azure platform, delivering production APIs and shared infrastructure supporting mobile and internal applications.
- Designed and implemented .NET 8 microservices, with a focus on API contracts, data integrity, and long-term maintainability in production environments.
- Led authentication and authorization architecture using Okta and Auth0 (OIDC), establishing secure identity flows across multiple services.
- Took primary ownership of database schema evolution and EF Core migrations for Postgres-backed systems, ensuring safe, repeatable production deployments.
- Designed and implemented centralized logging and observability libraries using the Elastic Stack, improving system visibility, debugging, and incident response.
- Built asynchronous messaging and notification workflows using Azure Service Bus and SendGrid to decouple services and improve reliability.
- Acted as a backend point-of-contact for mobile, DevOps, QA, and product teams, resolving cross-service integration and deployment issues.
- Facilitated sprint execution and release coordination across teams, improving delivery predictability during high-risk milestones.
- Contributed to architectural decisions around service boundaries, data modeling, and cloud resource usage, balancing delivery speed with long-term system health.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: 1950 Camino Vida Roble, Carlsbad CA 92008 · On-site
positions.description:
- Delivered full-stack features for production mobile and web applications using C# and ASP.NET, supporting clinical and internal users.
- Built cross-platform mobile functionality with Xamarin Forms, working across the stack from UI through backend integrations.
- Implemented secure authentication flows using Okta, contributing to consistent identity and access management across applications.
- Developed web interfaces with Blazor, integrating frontend components with backend services and APIs.
- Worked with Azure-hosted services including Cosmos DB and Azure App Service, gaining hands-on experience deploying and maintaining cloud-based applications.
- Collaborated in an Agile Scrum environment, contributing to sprint planning, execution, and retrospectives using Jira and Confluence.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Co-founded a successful wedding industry business, supporting long-term growth and operational stability.
- Managed business bookkeeping and tax preparation, ensuring accurate financial records and compliance.
- Maintained financial systems and reporting to support informed decision-making.
- Partnered with the operating founder to support sustainable business operations while remaining intentionally hands-off in day-to-day execution.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Start-up Leadership · Financial Accounting · Small Business

positions.title: Director Of Volunteers
positions.locationName: 456 E mission Rd suite 130 San Marcos CA 92069
positions.description:
(Volunteer Organization)
- Built, led, and scaled multiple volunteer teams across production, hospitality, events, and small groups, establishing clear ownership and accountability structures.
- Recruited, trained, and developed team leads, creating a leadership pipeline that enabled sustainable growth and reduced dependency on single points of failure.
- Defined roles, standards, and expectations through written job descriptions and training programs, improving clarity, consistency, and execution.
- Fostered a continuous improvement culture through regular feedback, training sessions, and team retrospectives.
- Planned and executed team-wide rallies, trainings, and conferences to strengthen alignment, morale, and shared vision.
- Collaborated with external organizational leaders to coordinate events and expand community reach.
- Managed cross-functional coordination for live events, balancing preparation, execution, and rapid problem-solving under time constraints.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Design · Leadership · Project Management

positions.title: Director Of Training
positions.description:
Chick-fil-A (Multi-Location, High-Volume)

- Led training and leadership development for 100+ team members across multiple locations in a high-volume, performance-driven operating environment.
- Designed and owned structured training systems, documentation, and onboarding programs to ensure consistent execution, quality, and leadership readiness.
- Built and managed a dedicated training team responsible for developing future Team Leaders, Shift Leaders, Supervisors, and General Managers.
- Mentored and coached leaders at multiple levels, contributing to internal promotions and long-term leadership pipeline development.
- Drove continuous improvement initiatives across restaurant operations, identifying process gaps and implementing scalable solutions.
- Collaborated with senior directors across departments to align standards, training, and cross-functional execution.
- Operated within a world-class leadership development model emphasizing ownership, accountability, excellence, and team culture.
positions.insights: Skills: Director level · Leadership · Delegation · New Hire Training · Servant Leadership · Project Management

positions.title: Small Business Owner
positions.locationName: 751 Rancheros Dr. Suite 13 San Marcos CA 92069 · On-site
positions.description:
Operations, Growth & Business Systems

- Founded and operated a small business, driving sustained revenue growth of over 20% year over year through disciplined operations and customer retention strategies.
- Owned end-to-end business operations, including pricing, customer relationships, vendor management, and day-to-day execution.
- Designed and implemented internal systems for customer records, job tracking, and operational reliability.
- Managed acquisition, maintenance, and utilization of capital assets, including printing equipment, balancing cost, quality, and long-term value.
- Negotiated and maintained relationships with contractors and suppliers to ensure consistent quality and delivery standards.
- Managed headquarters office leasing and facilities operations.
- Built and led a high-performance team culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and long-term sustainability.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Web Design · Successful Business Owner · Leadership · Project Management · HTML · Small Business

- Directed all audio, video, lighting, and broadcast production for a large, multi-service church with live-streamed services and high weekly attendance.
- Led and coordinated volunteer teams of 60+ across audio, video, lighting, and broadcast disciplines, ensuring consistent execution at scale.
- Oversaw broadcast production teams supporting live streaming and recorded content, maintaining quality, reliability, and redundancy in live environments.
- Designed and implemented production systems, standards, and training processes to support onboarding, consistency, and operational resilience.
- Partnered with worship, teaching, events, and operations leadership to deliver seamless, time-critical live experiences.
- Planned and executed production for conferences, special events, and high-attendance gatherings, managing complexity and real-time issue resolution.
- Built a culture of ownership, preparation, and continuous improvement within large volunteer production teams.
